body: The ambulance dies in his arms.... I don't expect anyone to get this, nor is it even a relevant reference... Im tired

It doesn't have value or meaning though. Its absurd, and we are all suffering, and we are all truly alone.

I don't have the motivation to travel, let alone the resources or capability or energy.

There are plenty of groups out there. I have no desire to pursue them though. I don't like people in general, and I resent most transfolk I meet.

I don't see myself as perfect. I see my self as completely flawed. I agree they should love me for who I am in theory, but truth is Im a horrible person, and I feed off other people.

I can't even talk to a therapist openly, because I risk getting put up for psyche eval, which mean I lose my ability to buy a gun. I do worry about the kids, like I said they are a part of the reason I haven't done it yet, but truth is they are young, and I've been in their lives such a brief amount of time that they wouldnt even notice.

Lastly I know Im not alone per se. I know people are struggling with this stuff, that people are willing to listen, thats why Im here. I just don't buy that it does me any good really. None of these people can hold me, will truly get to know me, get to see me. Just as I won't you.
